verdict.rationale: Orama's docs list official Cloud SDKs for JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and Rust, and the JS library runs in browsers and Deno. That covers only part of the requested language spread. The REST APIs are private, and users are directed to these SDKs, which makes the narrow SDK set more limiting. Missing for 10: PHP, Ruby and Go SDKs, framework-specific integrations, and any evidence of SDKs being kept current (release cadence or version parity).

support.subject: As a developer, official SDKs cover my language and framework, kept current across JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, and more

citations.quote: Orama Cloud officially supports the following SDKs: - JavaScript/TypeScript - Python - Rust
With Deno, you can just use the same CDN URL or use npm specifiers
